overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 57.66% annualised against 18.54% volatility (Sharpe 2.31) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 48.0%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 1.85% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.43% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -10.29%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 7.03%, 99% VaR 19.46%, CVaR 95% 14.99%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.96%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-69.47% return, max drawdown -72.63%, worst day -18.27%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 22.73% vs realised 22.71% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: XOM have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 5 positions. The most concentrated trade is BAC at 0.0% of 30-day ADV. At a 20% participation rate, the slowest unwind would be BAC at 0.0 trading days — manageable but worth keeping in mind for any rapid de-risk.
